versions.changelog: Pins @cognexuslabs/openclaw-artzain 0.2.7: the Decision API key follows no redirect (a 3xx blocks the tool call), and failures are reported without the error's text.

Pins plugin @cognexuslabs/openclaw-artzain@0.2.6 with its sha512 integrity and a verify-before-install step (npm audit signatures); states what the plugin sends and to which host; key prefix in the config example reads cnx_.
Plugin 0.2.1 released on npm (announce results now surface failed counts). Listing categories restored.

Listing-only update: licensing clarified. This listing text is MIT-0 (ClawHub licenses all published skills MIT-0). The plugin itself - npm @cognexuslabs/openclaw-artzain and its source - remains Apache-2.0. No code changes; npm stays at 0.2.0.
v0.2: opt-in instance announce (names-only identity) to the CogNEXUS Agent Wrangler; license label corrected to Apache-2.0.
Official listing: pointer to @cognexuslabs/openclaw-artzain on npm.
